crossRefs.note: He said, “Appoint me your wages, and I will give it.”
Your father has deceived me, and changed my wages ten times, but God didn’t allow him to hurt me.

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

people.name: Laban
people.line: Brother of Rebekah; father of Leah and Rachel

translations.web: Laban said to Jacob, “Because you are my relative, should you therefore serve me for nothing? Tell me, what will your wages be?”
translations.bsb: Laban said to him, “Just because you are my relative, should you work for nothing? Tell me what your wages should be.”
translations.kjv: And Laban said unto Jacob, Because thou art my brother, shouldest thou therefore serve me for nought? tell me, what shall thy wages
translations.asv: And Laban said unto Jacob, Because thou art my brother, shouldest thou therefore serve me for nought? Tell me, what shall thy wages be?
